title: Thirty-five of us now
text: Six people joined in July. Nobody was vetted; everybody was fed. The community page has the full list.

title: The long table has legs again
text: Two doors and a scaffolding board were rescued from a skip in Kreis 4. They will hold about forty plates.

title: A second kitchen
text: We can use the courtyard kitchen on Wipkingenplatz on Sundays until October. Ask if you want a key.

title: Photos from June are up
column4: Patricio and Nick emptied their cameras. The archive has ninety new pictures.
